special.rule: CONTRACT: integers are fresh-entry counts only under the conditions below. null means unknown/unreviewed, NEVER zero. All vanilla DOL motion IDs are included as a conservative superset; inclusion does not assert input reachability. Specific special rules override integers. Do not infer a total input tail from pre/post action IDs alone.

RUNTIME OVERRIDE: Fighter_ChangeMotionState flushes the previous action's pending effect queue before installing the new action. Each queued effect can execute effect-specific RNG synchronously. The integer applies only if that queue contributes zero draws. Otherwise replay the queue in order and add its draws; without queue/effect state the complete tail is UNKNOWN. This affects every state change, including zero-valued entries.

RUNTIME OVERRIDE: integers assume one ordinary fresh transition at animation start 0, speed 1, with the reviewed wrapper calls. Continued/skipped scripts, nonzero animation starts, item interactions, capture/victim transitions, additional transitions in the same input callback, and later followers require their own synchronous work. If those conditions are not established, the full tail is UNKNOWN. Read the final emitted pre-frame seed in actual fighter/follower execution order; do not double-count earlier fighters.

TIMING: ChangeMotionState calls the script interpreter immediately. Many wrappers call ftAnim_8006EBA4 once more, so a wait of 1 can expire before priority 4. Counts include both calls where present. GFX opcode 10 contributes 3 except its enumerated zero-draw branches; opcode 18 contributes 1 when the DAT smash SFX list exists; opcode 38 contributes 1 for random SFX choice; opcode 17 behavior 0 can contribute 1 for pitch randomization. Deferred accessory/physics/effect callbacks are not charged at startup.
